claims.head: The Golden Knights’ defense joins the attack; the Kings’ stays home
claims.body: The Golden Knights are near the top of the league for shots from defensemen, at the active D end; the Kings are the league’s worst, at the forward-led end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.nums: Shots from defensemen: Vegas 7th, Los Angeles 32nd
claims.gist: The Golden Knights and the Kings sit at opposite ends for shots from defensemen.
claims.call: The Golden Knights’ defensemen take a bigger share of the team’s shot attempts than the Kings’.

claims.head: One power play bites, one doesn’t
claims.body: On the power play, Vegas is one of the league’s best and Los Angeles is near the bottom of the league. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
claims.gist: The Golden Knights and the Kings sit at opposite ends for power play.

VGK.head: This one sets up well for Vegas
VGK.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Los Angeles’s only real way in is keeping dangerous shots away, and they would need a near-perfect night.

LAK.head: Los Angeles has their work cut out
LAK.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Los Angeles could still pull it off if they keep dangerous shots away, but they might need a miracle.
